name: Kessen wa Valentine
original_name: 決戦はヴァレンタイン
source:
It happened when I was still young.
My parents took me to an old playhouse.
What I saw there were sparkly and visually impressively beautiful plays on stage.
I was intrigued, blown away - totally absorbed in the action.

...To be frank, I had already forgotten was the plot was about.
But I remember how cool and stylish the protagonist looked.

Some time has passed and I'm using whatever pocket money I can save, to go and attend various stage plays.

During test period I obviously can't go, though. Later on I pass my exams and get into the girls school I desired. The time there is joyful, but also hectic and doesn't give me much free time to spend. Before I realize it, it is already winter.

I'm a third semester now.

And that is when I get a mail from a former classmate.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.antipasto-caffe.com/valentine/intro.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
那是在我还小的时候。
父母带我去了一个古老的剧场。
我在那里看到的是舞台上闪闪发光、视觉上令人印象深刻的美丽戏剧。
我被深深吸引，完全沉浸在剧情中。
……说实话，我已经忘记了剧情是什么。
但我记得主人公看起来有多酷、多帅。

一段时间过去了，我用省下的零花钱去看各种舞台剧。

考试期间当然不能去。后来我通过了考试，进入了心仪的女校。那里的时光快乐而忙碌，没有太多空闲时间。不知不觉间，冬天就到了。

我已经是第三学期了。

就在这时，我收到了一位前同学的邮件。

[翻译自[url=http://www.antipasto-caffe.com/valentine/intro.html]官网[/url]]
